# 1 Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
```

# 2 Daten einlesen und vorbereiten

```{r}
newdata <- read.csv("data_sorted_test - Kopie.csv")
str(newdata)
#entfernen überflüssiger spalten
#kommt evtl weg
newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(-(X:X.6))
str(newdata)
#spalten anders ordnen
newdata <- newdata %>%
  relocate(Transekt, Transektnummer, .after = Name)
str(newdata)

#convert to long_format
rownames(newdata) <- newdata$Name 
newdata$Name <- NULL 
ncol(newdata) 
str(newdata)
art_cols <- grep("_(TL|HL|ML|SL)$", names(newdata), value = TRUE)
new_long <- newdata %>%
  rownames_to_column("Name") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(art_cols), names_to = "Art_full", values_to = "Deckung") %>% 
  filter(Deckung > 0) %>%
  tidyr::separate(Art_full, into = c("Art", "Schicht"), sep = "_(?=[A-Z]{1,2}$)")
#Zeilen, mit 0 wurden entfernt -> verkürzt Datensatz
str(new_long)
```

# 2 Zeigerwerte einlesen

```{r}
# Zeigerwerte von GBIF
zeigerwerte <- read.table("dwca-zeigerwerte-v1.2/ellenberg.txt",sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
zeigerwerte <- zeigerwerte %>%
  rename(gbif_name = id)
# Liste meiner Arten, Artnamen für GBIF-Artnamen angepasst
mapping <- read_xlsx("artenliste_mapping.xlsx")

# Tabellen zusammenführen
zeiger_mapped <- zeigerwerte %>%
  inner_join(mapping, by = "gbif_name") %>%
  select(gbif_name, my_name, light, temperature, continental, wetness, alkalinity, nitrogen, salinity)

# Tabelle aufräumen
zeiger_mapped <- zeiger_mapped %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(light, temperature, continental, wetness, alkalinity, nitrogen, salinity),
    ~ str_remove_all(.x, "[~()xX=]") %>%
      as.numeric()
  ))
zeiger_mapped <- zeiger_mapped %>%
  rename(Art = my_name)
zeiger_mapped <- zeiger_mapped %>%
  select(-gbif_name)
```

3 gewichtete Zeigerwerte berechnen

```{r}
#gewichtete zeigerwerte berechnen
combined_data2 <- left_join(new_long, zeiger_mapped, by = "Art")
str(combined_data2)

weighted_values2 <- combined_data2 %>%
  group_by(plot.ID, Name, site, Transekt, Transektnummer) %>%
  summarise(
    Weighted_light = sum(Deckung * light, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Weighted_temperature = sum(Deckung * temperature, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Weighted_wetness = sum(Deckung * wetness, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Weighted_nitrogen = sum(Deckung * nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Weighted_continental = sum(Deckung * continental, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Weighted_alkalinity = sum(Deckung * alkalinity, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Weighted_salinity = sum(Deckung * salinity, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#write_xlsx(weighted_values, "Zeigerwerte_gewichtet.xlsx")
```

4 diversitätsmaße berechnen

```{r}
####species richness, Shannon Index, relative Häufigkeit und species evenness bestimmen####

#anlegen einer Vegetationsmatrix
comm_matrix <- veg_long %>%
  group_by(plot.ID, Art) %>%
  summarise(Deckung = sum(Deckung), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Art,
    values_from = Deckung,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("plot.ID")
str(comm_matrix)

#berechnen von species richness, shannon Index, relativer Häufigkeit und Evenness

species_richness <- specnumber(comm_matrix)
shannon_index <- diversity(comm_matrix, index = "shannon")
relative_freq <- decostand(comm_matrix, method = "total")
species_evenness <- shannon_index / log(specnumber(comm_matrix))

# Ergebnisse in ein Dataframe packen:

results <- data.frame(
  Plot = rownames(comm_matrix),
  Richness = species_richness,
  Shannon = shannon_index,
  Evenness = species_evenness
)

print(results)

#als Excel speichern
write_xlsx(results, "Ergebnisse_species_richness.xlsx")
```

5 deckungsdaten explorieren

```{r}
# Daten aufbereiten: Top 10 Arten pro Fläche + Sortierung pro Fläche
plot_data <- new_long %>%
  group_by(site, Art) %>%
  summarise(Mittelwert_Deckung = mean(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mittelwert_Deckung)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  # Sortierung pro Fläche als Faktor speichern
  mutate(Art = factor(Art, levels = rev(Art)))  # rev(), damit häufigste Art oben

# Plot erstellen
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Art, y = Mittelwert_Deckung, fill = site)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Häufigste Arten pro Fläche",
       x = "Art",
       y = "Mittlere Deckung [%]") +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "blue", "purple"))  # Eine Farbe pro Fläche (bunt)
```

```{r}
# Daten aufbereiten: Top 10 Arten pro Fläche + Sortierung pro Fläche
plot_data <- new_long %>%
  group_by(site, Art) %>%
  summarise(Mittelwert_Deckung = mean(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mittelwert_Deckung)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  # Sortierung pro Fläche als Faktor speichern (wichtig: pro Gruppe!)
  group_modify(~ .x %>% mutate(Art = factor(Art, levels = rev(.x$Art))))

# Plot erstellen
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Art, y = Mittelwert_Deckung, fill = site)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Häufigste Arten pro Fläche",
       x = "Art",
       y = "Mittlere Deckung [%]") +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +  # Mehr Platz zwischen Balken
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)  # Schriftgröße und Ausrichtung
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "blue", "purple"))
```

```{r}

library(patchwork)

# 1. Globales Maximum der Deckung über alle Flächen berechnen
global_max <- new_long %>%
  group_by(site, Art) %>%
  summarise(Mittelwert_Deckung = mean(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(Mittelwert_Deckung) %>%
  max(na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Daten pro Fläche aufbereiten und sortieren
flaechen <- unique(new_long$site)
farben <- c("darkgreen", "blue", "purple")
plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(flaechen)) {
  flaeche <- flaechen[i]

  data_flaeche <- new_long %>%
    filter(site == flaeche) %>%
    group_by(Art) %>%
    summarise(Mittelwert_Deckung = mean(Deckung, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Mittelwert_Deckung)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(Art = factor(Art, levels = rev(Art)))

  # Plot mit mehr Platz zwischen den Balken
  p <- ggplot(data_flaeche, aes(x = Art, y = Mittelwert_Deckung)) +
    geom_col(fill = farben[i]) +  # Balkenbreite bleibt standardmäßig
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = paste("Häufigste Arten in", flaeche),
         x = "Art",
         y = "Mittlere Deckung [%]") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.001)) +  # Abstand zwischen den Kategorien auf der x-Achse
    ylim(0, global_max)

  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# 3. Plots vertikal anordnen
reduce(plot_list, `+`) + plot_layout(ncol = 1)
```
